name: SohoPay Agent Skills
description: Skill index for AI agents integrating with the SohoPay MCP gateway, merchant-as-settler x402, and credit settlement.

skills.name: setup
skills.title: SohoPay Agent Setup for AI Agents
skills.description: Env-parameterized bootstrap: detect harness, install skills, connect MCP (prod or staging), onboard, operate, troubleshoot, and report.

skills.name: setup-staging
skills.title: SohoPay Agent Setup (Staging)
skills.description: Staging env-preset stub: pins staging.api / staging.mcp and chains to the canonical setup skill.

skills.name: mcp-connect
skills.title: Connect to SohoPay MCP Server
skills.description: Per-harness registration (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Hermes, ChatGPT) for hosted or local MCP; read the live tools/list; idempotency_key for header-less clients.

skills.name: mcp-connect-staging
skills.title: Connect to SohoPay MCP Server (Staging)
skills.description: Staging env-preset stub: sohopay-staging → staging.mcp.sohopay.xyz/mcp; chains to canonical mcp-connect.

skills.name: borrower-onboard
skills.title: SohoPay Borrower Onboarding
skills.description: whoami, register, wallet proof (challenge_id submit), scope-gated tokens, dropped scopes.

skills.name: human-direct-flow
skills.title: SohoPay Human-Direct Flow
skills.description: Default operate path: whoami, onboard, spend, policy, sign, x402 merchant-as-settler, poll by settlement_id.

skills.name: spend-and-pay
skills.title: SohoPay Spend, Policy, and Signing
skills.description: Spend intents (merchant XOR merchant_id), policy, intentSig via get_signing_status, x402 settle, poll by settlement_id.

skills.name: x402-credit-pay
skills.title: SohoPay x402 Credit Settlement
skills.description: Merchant-as-settler X-PAYMENT primary path; facilitator API for merchants; borrower-direct /api/v2/x402 secondary.

skills.name: idempotency
skills.title: SohoPay Idempotency
skills.description: idempotency_key tool arg for Cursor/ChatGPT, per-route TTLs, exempt routes, (userId, key) scope.
